question: Does the scale-1280 Development candidate retain useful detector, tracking and vehicle-subclass performance outside the BDD100K H3 domain when compared on identical footage against the scale-640 A2 Development reference, and what domain-specific tracking cost accompanies that gain?

producers.causalDifference: detector Model Pack only (test Resize/Pad 640 vs 1280); one A2 profile, one checkpoint, one Runtime Pack
producers.order: within each partition the reference arm (a2-scale640) runs first, then the candidate (a2-scale1280)

domains.description: Aerial drone video, low to medium altitude, 14 Chinese cities, many resolutions (680x382 to 3840x2160).

frameTime.status: assumption: the release states no frame rate; both arms share it

selection.rule: all sequences of both GT-available splits (complete sequences; no subset)

domains.researchUse: RESEARCH-UNCERTAIN (no licence statement; toolkit 'for research purpose only')
domains.conditions: none annotated per sequence; source resolution recorded per sequence

domains.description: Aerial drone video, low/medium/high altitude, front/side/bird views, daylight, night and fog, China.
domains.status: conditional on acquisition: the authors' Google Drive returned 'Quota exceeded' on 2026-10-06; the downloader retries automatically. If the archives cannot be acquired before the VisDrone arms complete and the retry window (60 rounds x 10 min) ends, UAVDT is recorded as unavailable for this event.

frameTime.status: stated by the authors (project page: 1080x540 at 30 fps)

selection.rule: all 50 UAVDT-Benchmark-M sequences listed in M_attr.zip (official test split, 20, and train split, 30), complete sequences, prepared as two partitions; no subset

mapping.note: the only native classes; no motorcycle or van class; written definitions unavailable

domains.ignoreSemantics: the release's ignore areas become ignoreRegions; out-of-view and occlusion flags do not change ground truth
domains.adapter: uavdt-m version 1, implemented to these frozen rules once the annotation bytes are available, with tests; its exact code identity is recorded with the UAVDT partitions' derivation manifests
domains.conditions: per sequence from M_attr.zip: illumination (daylight/night/fog), altitude (low/medium/high), view (front/side/bird, multi-label), long-term

unavailable.reason: the original site redirects to a lab page with no download link (2026-10-06); no authoritative copy; mirrors not used
download requires account registration; not automatable

derivation.rule: each partition prepared exactly once into a write-once directory; reused while its frozen descriptor, adapter, derived-video and GT hashes verify

execution.tool: tools.benchmarks.cli execute --development-producer <id> (PR #174 producer binding, journal binding, per-export attestation check)
execution.isolation: each unit has its own fresh PostgreSQL catalogue, media store, evidence root, journal, exports directory, logs and receipt
execution.sentinel: the worker is started with Start-MaviVisionWorker.ps1 -DevelopmentProducer <id> after -VerifyOnly passes; execute checks every export's attested producer against the frozen tuple immediately after that run, so a wrong producer stops the unit at its first sequence
execution.resume: an interrupted unit is resumed only by re-running the identical execute command on the same journal and catalogue

failureClasses.infrastructure: repair without changing the experimental variable; rerun only the affected work under a recorded attempt
failureClasses.product: a deterministic processing failure under a valid producer is H4 evidence; never retried away

execution.wrongProducer: stop the unit; preserve and mark the attempt invalid; diagnose; rerun only that unit under a new attempt id
execution.receipt: tools.benchmarks.h4.receipt build/verify; a verified receipt makes the unit's inference immutable

evaluation.tool: tools.benchmarks.cli evaluate per unit; tools.benchmarks.h4.compare per domain
perArm: expected-vehicle GT outcomes (total, assigned, ambiguous, merged, fragmented, unverified, unmatched)
Vehicle Tracks (total, assigned, fragment, unverified, ignored, unmatched)
Scope B subclass block per class (support, recall, precision, accuracy, undetermined, confusion)
frame rate and source resolution per sequence
paired: paired partition-stratified sequence bootstrap 95% interval of deltaAssociation
extra Vehicle Tracks, extra fragmented GT and extra fragment MAVI Tracks per extra assigned GT (only when deltaAssigned > 0)
strata: GT median source height band: <20, 20-40, 40-80, 80-160, >=160 px (H3 bands)
UAVDT sequence conditions (illumination, altitude, view, long-term)
evaluation.notReported: max_per_img saturation: the formal runs record track outputs only, not per-frame detector candidates

rules: no pass/fail threshold is set from H4 results
arms are compared only within a domain
H3 BDD100K figures are context and never pooled with H4
each dataset contributes only to the classes its taxonomy supports
domain differences are evidence, not defects
